title: A reviewer's finding
description: Every reviewer's output contract. The rule 'propose no fix for §A' is VALIDATION here, not a request to the model.

class.description: a class de guardrail que este finding toca, ou null

evidence.description: literal: arquivo e linha. Achado sem evidência não é finding.

consequence.description: o que acontece neste código, não em tese

form.description: the shape of the fix; MUST be null when the class belongs to §A

attributable.description: false = o finding é do projeto, não desta mudança; não bloqueia

criterion.description: the id of the item's acceptance criterion this finding bears on, when it is about one; the judge then charges it at gate 3 (what the item asked for), not at gate 1

consequence_kind.description: the verifier's second reading of the severity: what kind of consequence the finding really has; `record`, `convention` and `proof_extra` are charged as a nit by the judge whatever the label

verifier_reason.description: the verifier's one sentence, or why the finding was not sent to it

beyond_item.description: The consequence lands on a consumer the item does not name, reached because the change widened something it shares. The fix returns that consumer to the base; it never adapts the consumer to the widening.

rule.description: the project's own text that states the rule this finding charges — the profile, the repository's instructions, a convention file — quoted; `verified` is the harness's: whether the quote was found in that file. A blocking finding needs a criterion, a verified rule, or a behaviour defect the verifier confirmed

already_reviewed.description: raised in a later round on code an earlier round already read and the push did not change: shown, never charged

also_raised_by.description: the other reviewers that raised the same cause; their copies were merged into this finding

carried_from.description: the review package this finding was raised in, when a later round carries it because it is still open

allOf.$comment: §A é decisão humana: o harness descreve a pergunta e as portas, nunca a correção.
